CLOOT.Title: Loot: {name}
CLOOT.WaitForGM: The GM has not released this loot yet.
CLOOT.GMHint: As GM, also select a token of your own to take loot yourself. Players see their buttons here.
CLOOT.ChooseHint: Several corpses in range. Which one do you want to search?
CLOOT.Keybind.Loot: Loot corpse (hover it, or stand nearby)
CLOOT.Setting.Range.Name: Looting range
CLOOT.Setting.Range.Hint: In scene units (usually feet). 10 means adjacent or one square apart.
CLOOT.Setting.Accent.Name: Accent colour
CLOOT.Setting.Accent.Hint: Colour of the section bars in the loot window. Match it to your character sheet.
CLOOT.Notify.SelectToken: Please select exactly one of your own tokens.
CLOOT.Chat.TakeGroup: {who} puts {what} from {from} into the party inventory ({group}).
CLOOT.Chat.Released: The loot of {name} has been released.
CLOOT.Err.Internal: That did not work. See the GM's console (F12) for details.
CLOOT.Err.NotDead: This NPC is not dead (skull status missing).
CLOOT.Err.OtherScene: The token is on a different scene.
CLOOT.Err.Locked: The loot has not been released yet.
CLOOT.Err.NoGroup: No party inventory found. Please pick one in the module settings.
CLOOT.Err.GMOnly: Only the GM may do that.
CLOOT.Err.Crash: Spoils & Skullduggery: error ({msg}). See the console (F12) for details.
CLOOT.RollHint: Rolls this NPC's loot table for this token. Previously rolled loot is replaced.
CLOOT.Setting.RollWhen.Name: Roll loot table
CLOOT.Setting.RollWhen.Hint: When should an NPC's loot table be rolled? Rolled per token and only once (unless you reroll manually).
CLOOT.Setting.RollWhen.placement: As soon as the token is placed on the map
CLOOT.Setting.RollWhen.manual: Manual only (button in the loot window)
CLOOT.Setting.DoubleClick.Name: Double-click to loot (players)
CLOOT.Setting.DoubleClick.Hint: Players can open a corpse by double-clicking it while one of their own tokens is selected.
CLOOT.Table.Title: Loot table: {name}
CLOOT.Table.Intro: Every token of this NPC rolls its own loot. Fixed equipment goes into the NPC's normal inventory; all tokens share it.
CLOOT.Table.CoinsHint: Coins already in the NPC's inventory stay as a fixed amount on top.
CLOOT.Table.DropSpecial: Drag an item here (e.g. healing potion)
CLOOT.Table.NotAnItem: That is not an item that works as loot.
CLOOT.Notify.TableNeedsNpc: Loot tables only exist for NPC actors.
CLOOT.Err.NoTable: This NPC has no loot table.
CLOOT.Err.TableOff: The loot table is switched off.
CLOOT.Err.Linked: This token is linked to its actor. Please turn off "Link actor data" in the token settings, otherwise all tokens share the loot.
CLOOT.Err.AlreadyRolled: Loot has already been rolled for this token.
CLOOT.GMDrop: Drag an item here to give it to this token
CLOOT.Setting.AutoRelease.Name: Release loot automatically
CLOOT.Setting.AutoRelease.Hint: Off (default): the GM releases each corpse's loot in the loot window. On: players can loot as soon as the NPC is dead.
CLOOT.Setting.ShowHud.Name: Show loot button in the right-click menu
CLOOT.Setting.ShowHud.Hint: Only for you. Off: you loot with the L key or by double-click only.
CLOOT.Setting.Party.Name: Party inventory
CLOOT.Setting.Party.Hint: Where the "To party" button puts loot. Automatic uses the dnd5e primary party, else the character's group, else the only Item Piles vault. Item Piles vaults and groups are listed.
CLOOT.Chat.HarvestOk: {who} passes the check and harvests {label} from {from}: {what}
CLOOT.Err.NoHarvest: This harvest step no longer exists.
CLOOT.Err.HarvestFailed: Your attempt failed. Another character may still try.
CLOOT.Harvest.Title: Harvest: {name}
CLOOT.Harvest.Intro: For animals: every step (e.g. meat, hide) stays locked until a player passes the check. Then the step's yield drops into the loot. Players never see the DC.
CLOOT.Harvest.DropItem: Drag the yield here (e.g. raw meat)
CLOOT.Harvest.Success: Success! The yield is now in the loot.
CLOOT.Chat.ToolUsed: {tool} is used up in the process.
CLOOT.Harvest.Label: Step name
CLOOT.Cfg.CoinHelp: Each token rolls a random value between From and To. Coins already in the NPC's inventory stay as a fixed amount on top.
CLOOT.Cfg.AmmoHint: Drag ammunition or other supplies here. Always drops, the amount is rolled randomly.
CLOOT.Cfg.AmmoHelp: Every entry drops for every token. Only the amount varies between From and To.
CLOOT.Cfg.ExtraHint: Drag items here. They only drop with their drop chance.
CLOOT.Cfg.ExtraHelp: Each item is rolled separately: at 25 % about every fourth token gets it. The amount varies between From and To.
CLOOT.Cfg.PreviewHint: What a single token's loot could look like. Nothing here is saved or handed out.
CLOOT.Cfg.PreviewEmpty: No test roll yet. Click "Test" below.
CLOOT.Cfg.PreviewNothing: Nothing drops this time. That is possible with the current values.
CLOOT.Setting.Bag.Name: Pouch look (just for you)
CLOOT.Setting.Bag.Hint: Shows the loot window as a leather pouch. If the pictures do not display correctly for you, switch it off here: you get a plain window with the same functions.
CLOOT.Setting.Pickpocket.Name: Allow pickpocketing
CLOOT.Setting.Pickpocket.Hint: Players can rob living NPCs: Sleight of Hand against the target's DC. The GM can change this per token in the loot window.
CLOOT.Err.PickDone: You already succeeded. The GM still has to release the loot.
CLOOT.Err.PickFailed: You were caught. The GM has to allow another try.
CLOOT.Err.NoLockOptions: This door has neither a key nor a DC for picking set.
CLOOT.Err.NoKey: You do not carry a matching key.
CLOOT.Chat.PickOkGM: {who} successfully robbed {target} (Sleight of Hand {total} vs DC {dc}). Decide in the loot window what {who} manages to grab: the round buttons on each item release it.
CLOOT.Pick.Intro: This creature is still alive. With a Sleight of Hand check you can try to rob it unnoticed.
CLOOT.Pick.Failed: You were caught. You only get this one attempt.
CLOOT.Pick.Waiting: Success! You can see what the target carries. The GM decides what you actually manage to grab.
CLOOT.Pick.Success: Success! The GM decides what you grab.
CLOOT.Pick.DCHint: Leave empty to use the target's passive Perception ({passive}).
CLOOT.Door.Title: Locked door
CLOOT.Door.NoKey: You do not carry a matching key.
CLOOT.Door.CanPick: You can try to pick the lock (Sleight of Hand).
CLOOT.Door.NeedTools: You need thieves' tools to pick it.
CLOOT.Door.SectionHint: Only applies to doors set to "Locked".
CLOOT.Door.DCHint: Leave empty: the lock cannot be picked, only opened with a key.
CLOOT.Door.KeyDrop: Drag the key here or type its name
CLOOT.Door.KeyHint: Anyone carrying an item with exactly this name can unlock the door. Leave empty for no key.
CLOOT.Pick.ItemFor: Release for this thief (tap the button)
CLOOT.Pick.CoinsFor: Release the coins for this thief
CLOOT.Door.MaxTriesHint: How often each character may try to pick the lock. The roll counts, not opening the window. Empty = unlimited.
CLOOT.Door.TriesReset: The attempts on this door were reset.
CLOOT.Err.NoTries: You have no attempts left on this lock.
CLOOT.Menu.Name: Ascandir
CLOOT.Menu.Title: Ascandir
CLOOT.Menu.Intro: What do you want to configure for {name}?
CLOOT.Thief.Title: Thievery: {name}
CLOOT.Thief.IntroToken: Settings for this token. Players can rob it if allowed.
CLOOT.Thief.IntroProto: Applies to all tokens placed from this actor from now on. Change tokens already on the map through their right-click menu.
CLOOT.Container.Hint: Chest, barrel, cupboard ... Drag items in or use “Loot table” for random loot. Every placed token rolls its own loot.
CLOOT.Box.Title: Lock: {name}
CLOOT.Box.IntroToken: Applies to this container on the map. Without a DC and without a key it cannot be opened.
CLOOT.Box.IntroProto: Applies to all containers placed from this template from now on. Change tokens already on the map through their menu.
CLOOT.Chat.BoxPickFail: {who} fails to pick the lock of “{target}”.
